main_body: multi-story brick campus building with flat green roof
top_band: grey parapet and green copper/tiled roof plane with rooftop vents (rows 1-41)
evidence: Rows 1-41 clearly depict the top surface of the building (a bordered flat green roof with rooftop vents seen from above). Below the front parapet/cornice (rows 38-46), rows 47-143 show the three-story brick front facade with recessed windows, window sills/lintels, and a recessed arched double-door entrance.

style.evidence: The building features rich brick patterning with 4-5 value steps of reddish-brown, detailed green roof tiles with weathering specks, multi-tone window reflections, stone trim, and material-colored dark outlines without any large flat fills.
